_: The cloud Claude's tools (plan step 2.1, 2026-10-26): ONE list for both engines of the script step, the API engine (tools/ci/claude-run.mjs) and the OAuth one (the Claude Code Action, whose claude_args 'claude token' builds from this file with 'node tools/ci/claude-run.mjs args'). The topic is typed on a website, so the tools are narrow: Claude writes only under specs/ and src/scenes/film/ and runs only these existing scripts, never one it wrote. A new command in ci/prompt.md or ci/slides.md goes here too. maxTurns: 200 since the r3 verify (2026-10-27; 140 since plan step 1.3, 110 before). It is the CLI's --max-turns: model ROUNDS, not tool results. The result's num_turns counts every tool result (parallel and refused calls each add one), so the p4 writers finished at num_turns 160 and 172 inside 140 rounds, and the action's own num_turns > maxTurns check threw the finished OAuth film away; studio.yml now accepts such a finished run (claude-run.mjs accept) and the film gate re-checks it.
